subject: Action: finalize marketplace support hour mapping & brand-localization for listing
messages:
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: listings@aws-partner.com
Date: 2028-07-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace listing — support hour mapping & brand localization

Hi Connor / Laura / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. AWS Listings team asked us to produce a final support-hour mapping and the localized marketing copy for the listing page by next week so they can publish on 7/18. Two specific asks from their side:

1) Confirm the exact support window we will present in the marketplace (time zone mapping + escalation routing). They want both displayed vendor support hours and an operational fallback for out-of-hours incidents.
2) Approve the localized brand claims for EN/ES (they highlighted the "HIPAA-ready" phrasing for the US and want the Spanish translation to avoid overstating compliance).

I've attached the AWS requirements doc they sent and included their contact in cc. Can you share the Redwood support-hour matrix and the proposed copy for both languages? If you need Acme to sign any attestation or provide their expected SLAs for co-sell, let me know.

Thanks,
Alice
---
Alice Zhang
Director, Product Partnerships
Acme Health
[Attachment: acme_marketplace_requirements_2028.pdf (pdf)]

From: connor.obrien@redwood.com <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, listings@aws-partner.com
Date: 2028-07-05T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hour mapping & brand localization

Alice — thanks, got it. Attaching our draft support-hour matrix and a first-pass localized copy. High-level proposals:

- Public listing copy: display vendor hours in buyer's local timezone (we'll supply timezone offsets for the three target markets).
- Out-of-hours: show a standard "Emergency response within 4 hours" fallback for dedicated contract customers; for self-serve customers we display "Next-business-day handling" and an inline note that severity-based escalation is available for Dedicated deployments.

Open questions for Acme and the listings team:
- Do you need us to explicitly state "HIPAA-compliant" on the listing, or is "HIPAA-ready / supports HIPAA workflows" safer for marketplace copy?
- For Spanish copy, do you want a literal translation or a marketing-localized variant?

Next steps: Ben will propose concrete hour blocks (PST/EST/CET) and Laura will confirm legal language. If that sounds right, we'll lock by EOD 7/06 so the AWS team has 7 business days to stage.

Connor
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rw_support_hour_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

On 2028-07-05 at 09:12, Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. AWS Listings team asked us to produce a final support-hour mapping and the localized marketing copy for the listing page by next week so they can publish on 7/18.

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>, listings@aws-partner.com
Date: 2028-07-06T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hour mapping & brand localization

Quick legal heads-up:

- Avoid using the unqualified phrase "HIPAA-compliant" on the public listing unless Acme provides proof and we have contract language that binds both parties. "Supports HIPAA workflows" or "HIPAA-ready with appropriate configurations" is preferable.
- Any claim about "24/7 incident response" must be tied to a support tier and an escalation path — otherwise AWS will flag it during review.

Connor — can you add a short footnote in the listing copy that ties claims to the support tier (e.g., "Available for Dedicated / Enterprise customers with active SLA")? Also, send the SOC2/TSP or any attestation Acme can provide. I can draft the minimal legal qualifier we can append to the Spanish copy so the translation doesn't overpromise.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal — Redwood Inference

On 2028-07-05 at 11:05, connor.obrien@redwood.com wrote:
> Alice — thanks, got it. Attaching our draft support-hour matrix and a first-pass localized copy.

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>, listings@aws-partner.com
Date: 2028-07-06T14:45:00Z
Subject: Proposed support-hour blocks and marketplace copy

Attaching the support-hour proposal. Summary:

- US (PST): 08:00–18:00 PST (Mon–Fri) — Primary phone/email support; 24/7 alerting for Dedicated customers with a 4-hour on-call response for Sev1.
- US (EST): 08:00–18:00 EST (Mon–Fri) — mirrored.
- EMEA (CET): 09:00–17:00 CET (Mon–Fri) — same-day response; escalation to 4-hour window for regional enterprise contracts.

Suggested public listing copy (EN): "Redwood Inference offers enterprise-grade model inference with configurable support tiers. Vendor support hours are shown per region; 24/7 incident response is available for Dedicated customers with an active SLA."

Spanish (draft, marketing-localized): "Redwood Inference ofrece inferencia de modelos para empresas con niveles de soporte configurables. Las horas de atención se muestran por región; respuesta las 24 horas está disponible para clientes Dedicated con SLA activo."

Connor / Laura —Ben recommends the "HIPAA-ready" phrasing in EN and the Spanish translation above with Laura's footnote appended.

Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: brand_copy_localization_draft.docx (docx)]

On 2028-07-06 at 08:30, laura.bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Quick legal heads-up:
>
> - Avoid using the unqualified phrase "HIPAA-compliant" on the public listing unless Acme provides proof and we have contract language that binds both parties.

From: connor.obrien@redwood.com <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: listings@aws-partner.com
Date: 2028-07-07T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — support hour mapping & brand localization (final items + action plan)

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps so we can meet the AWS staging deadline: 

1) Listing copy approved in principle — use Ben's EN/ES drafts. Laura will append the legal qualifier: "Available for Dedicated / Enterprise customers with active SLA; symbolic references to regulatory compliance are subject to partner attestation." Laura to send the one-line qualifier by 7/07 17:00 PST.
2) Support hours locked: publish vendor hours by region (Ben's matrix). For Dedicated customers we will advertise 24/7 incident handling with a 4-hour Sev1 target. For self-serve we will show business-hours response; escalation language included.
3) Evidence requested: Alice / Acme to provide SOC2 Type II report or equivalent attestation by 7/10 so we can include the partner attestation link in the listing.
4) Deliverables and owners:
   - Ben: finalize hour matrix spreadsheet and export to CSV for the AWS form (due 7/07 EOD).
   - Laura: legal qualifier text for EN/ES (due 7/07 17:00 PST).
   - Connor: update the listings form and submit to AWS for staging once Ben's CSV and Laura's qualifier are in place (target 7/07 20:00 PST).

Alice — can you confirm Acme will provide the SOC2 attestation by 7/10 and confirm whether you prefer literal or marketing-localized Spanish? If yes to localized, Ben will route to our localization contractor for a final pass.

I'll follow up with the AWS listing contact in cc once we have the updated CSV + copy.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
[Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMarketplaceEvidence]
